BC-2 Combo Drive by BOSS | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE BOSS BC-2 Combo Drive LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE DISTORTION Description The BOSS BC-2 gives you the sound of a classic “AC-inspired” British combo amp in a pedal format – but that’s just the beginning. With a single knob, you can directly influence several parameters that control the sound characteristics and thus choose from a variety of different sounds. Fix the perfect vintage twist or dial in more gain or cleaner sound from a wider range than the classic amp could have on its own. The BC-2 also gives you a natural and dynamic response to your pick playing regardless of the settings of the controls. This easy-to-use – yet technically complex – pedal takes you from authentic vintage sound to the more expansive sounds of the new generation. What’s New Backstage Log In Sign Up Newsletter Sign Up Find a Dealer × BC-2 Combo Drive Discontinued British Combo-Amp Tone and Beyond The new BOSS BC-2 generates a classic “AC-inspired” British combo-amp tone in a compact pedal, but that’s just the starting point. With a single knob, you can instantly control a variety of sound-character parameters, and quickly tap into a full spectrum of tone. Achieve the perfect vintage sound or dial into higher gain or cleaner tone across a wider frequency range than the classic amp could provide on its own. The BC-2 also offers a natural and dynamic response to your picking nuances at any setting. This easy-to-use yet technically complex pedal takes you from authentic vintage tone to expanded new-generation performance and sound. Wide range of tones with a single knob —from classic crisp clean and punchy crunch to creamy overdrive with long sustain and beyond Natural and dynamic response to picking nuance at any knob position Provides warm combo tones and authentic combo-amp cabinet resonance Home Discontinued BC-2 Home BC-2 Features Specs Accessories --> Accessories Downloads --> Downloads Support • < > Video Library BC-2 Overview Introducing the BC-2 Combo Drive. SOUND Knob The SOUND knob adjusts multiple parameters simultaneously across a range of zones. Smoothly transition from fat and clean tone in left zone to high-impact crunch in the upper zone and high-gain distortion in the right zone. Find the perfect classic setting or go beyond previous limits. Crank the SOUND knob to the DRIVE position, for example, and get a creamier high-gain tone than the classic combo could provide, as if you were driving the amp with an external booster. Likewise, if you turn the knob to the CLEAN position, you can clean up the tone across a wider frequency range than the original amp could deliver. A universe of great tone is as simple as a single knob twist. EQ and LEVEL Knobs Dedicated EQ knobs are provided for instantly sculpting your tone. The BASS knob provides direct control of the lower-frequency range; the TREBLE knob provides control of upper frequencies. A master LEVEL knob controls the overall volume of the pedal when it is turned on. INPUT Jack The INPUT jack accepts signals from a guitar, another musical instrument, or another effect unit. This jack also doubles as the power switch. Power to the unit is turned on when you plug into the INPUT jack; the power is turned off when the cable is unplugged.
